items.title: One of America’s largest reservoirs just hit a record low
items.title_en: One of America’s largest reservoirs just hit a record low
items.title_zh: 美国最大的水库之一刚刚创下历史最低水位纪录
items.summary_en: Lake Powell has fallen to its lowest level on record after an exceptionally dry and warm winter left the Colorado River Basin with little mountain snow to melt. Lake Mead also reached record lows, raising concerns for a river system that supplies water and power to more than 40 million people. Federal officials have taken emergency steps to stabilize Lake Powell, including sending in water from another reservoir and reducing releases downstream.

items.title: Reducing nitrate loads to the St. Lawrence river could mitigate hypoxia and acidification in its deep estuary and Gulf
items.title_en: Reducing nitrate loads to the St. Lawrence river could mitigate hypoxia and acidification in its deep estuary and Gulf
items.title_zh: 减少流入圣劳伦斯河的硝酸盐负荷，有望缓解该河深水河口及海湾地区的缺氧和酸化问题
items.summary_en: Hypoxia in marine systems is expanding worldwide due to anthropogenic activities. Deep waters of the St. Lawrence Estuary and Gulf are rapidly deoxygenating (∼1 mmol O2 m−3 y−1), driven by changes in Atlantic water-mass intrusion and nutrient‐fueled remineralization, and are simultaneously acidifying (∼0.004 pH unit y−1). These changes alter biogeochemical cycles and degrade habitats, causing biotic and economic consequences. Using a coupled physical-biogeochemical model, we tested whether watershed-scale nitrate reductions could mitigate deep‐water deoxygenation and carbonate-system degradation. Three nitrate‐reduction scenarios reduced riverine St. Lawrence River nitrate loads by about 11%, 30%, and 50% (−2.8, −7.5, and −11.7 mmol N m−3, respectively). Relative to the baseline simulation, these scenarios increased dissolved oxygen concentrations (DO) (+1.6, +4.3, and +6.7 mmol O2 m−3), pH (+0.004, +0.010, and +0.016), and aragonite saturation state (Ωarag) (+0.003, +0.009, and +0.015) in the deep Laurentian Channel (⩾175 m). The volume of deep waters with DO saturation <30% decreased by 3%, 8%, and 13% (−27, −75, −122 km3), while volumes with pH <7.65 declined by 1.0%, 2.8%, and 4.5% (−22, −60, −96 km3). Severely corrosive waters (Ωarag <0.6) dropped by 1.4%, 3.7%, and 5.9% (−26, −71, −112 km3). Over 2014–2024, modelled improvements exceeded small interannual variability but remained within seasonal amplitudes of deep DO concentrations (∼11 mmol O2 m−3) and pH (∼0.015 units), nevertheless pointing to a detectable management signal. Although nutrient‐driven improvements remained smaller than climate‐forced trends, modelled nitrate load reductions could offset ∼56% and 80% of recent observed oxygen and pH declines, respectively, while reducing hypoxic and acidified (pH and Ωarag) water volumes. These findings provide quantitative evidence that watershed‐scale nitrogen mitigation, through improved agricultural practices and wastewater nitrogen removal, which necessitates cooperation across jurisdictions, can alleviate hypoxia and acidification in deep coastal ecosystems, making nutrient management an essential complement to climate adaptation strategies.
items.summary_zh: 由于人类活动的影响，全球海洋系统中的缺氧现象正在不断扩大。 受大西洋水团侵入变化和营养盐驱动的再矿化作用影响，圣劳伦斯河口及海湾的深层水正迅速缺氧（约1 mmol O₂ m⁻³ y⁻¹），同时也在酸化（约0.004 pH单位 y⁻¹）。 这些变化改变了生物地球化学循环并破坏了栖息地，从而导致了生物和经济方面的后果。我们利用一个耦合的物理-生物地球化学模型，测试了流域尺度的硝酸盐削减是否能够缓解深水缺氧和碳酸盐系统的退化。 三种硝酸盐削减情景分别将圣劳伦斯河的硝酸盐负荷降低了约 11%、30% 和 50%（分别减少 2.8、7.5 和 11.7 mmol N m−3）。 与基准模拟相比，这些情景提高了溶解氧浓度（DO）（+1.6、+4.3 和 +6.7 mmol O₂ m⁻³）、pH 值（+0.004、+0.010 和 +0.016）以及文石饱和度 (Ωarag)（+0.003、+0.009 和 +0.015）。 溶解氧饱和度<30%的深层水体体积分别减少了3%、8%和13%（−27、−75、−122 km³），而pH值<7.65的水体体积则分别减少了1.0%、 2.8% 和 4.5%（−22、−60、−96 km3）。 强腐蚀性水体（Ωarag <0.6）的体积分别减少了1.4%、3.7%和5.9%（−26、−71、−112 km³）。 在2014–2024年期间，模型模拟的改善幅度虽超过了微小的年际变异性，但仍处于深层溶解氧浓度（∼11 mmol O₂ m⁻³）和pH值（∼0.015单位）的季节性波动范围内，尽管如此，这仍表明存在可检测的管理信号。 尽管由营养盐驱动的改善幅度仍小于气候驱动的趋势，但模型模拟的硝酸盐负荷削减量可分别抵消近期观测到的溶解氧和pH值下降幅度的约56%和80%，同时减少缺氧和酸化（pH值和Ωarag）水体的体积。 这些发现提供了定量证据，表明通过改进农业实践和废水脱氮，在流域层面实施氮减排——这需要……

items.title: Amazon study reveals the best strategies for protecting biodiversity and carbon
items.title_en: Amazon study reveals the best strategies for protecting biodiversity and carbon
items.title_zh: 亚马逊的一项研究揭示了保护生物多样性和碳的最佳策略
items.summary_en: A large Amazon study suggests the most powerful conservation move may be protecting the forests that are already standing. Preventing damage from wildfires and logging delivered the greatest biodiversity benefits and nearly matched deforestation prevention for protecting carbon. Restoration remains important, particularly where forests have already been heavily cleared, but it was more expensive and less effective on its own.
items.summary_zh: 一项针对亚马逊地区的大型研究表明，最有效的保护措施可能是保护现有的森林。防止森林火灾和砍伐造成的破坏，对生物多样性带来的益处最大，且在保护碳储量方面几乎与防止森林砍伐的效果相当。森林恢复依然重要，特别是在森林已被大规模砍伐的地区，但仅靠森林恢复的成本更高，且效果较差。

items.title_zh: 加利福尼亚州正为创纪录的“厄尔尼诺”风暴做准备，州长已宣布进入紧急状态
items.summary_en: Super El-Niño has already broken temperature records and is predicted to bring an extremely wet winter to the state‘Jaw-dropping’ El Niño bursts through temperature record months before peakCalifornia is bracing for a record breaking El Niño that is expected to bring severe winter storms and flooding across the state, with the state’s governor declaring a state of emergency in anticipation of extreme weather in the months ahead.The global climate phenomenon known as a “super El Niño” is already breaking temperature records and drawing predictions of an extremely wet winter in places such as California, where El Niño typically brings more severe winter storms and flooding risks. Several coastal California cities have recently faced high surf, flooding and coastal erosion linked to Hurricane Marie as well as El Niño. Experts have said the effects offered a glimpse at what the coming winter could look like. Continue reading...
items.summary_zh: “超级厄尔尼诺”现象已打破气温纪录，预计将给该州带来一个异常多雨的冬季‘“令人瞠目结舌”的厄尔尼诺现象在达到峰值前数月便已打破气温纪录。加利福尼亚州正严阵以待这场破纪录的厄尔尼诺现象，预计它将给全州带来严重的冬季风暴和洪水，该州州长已预见到未来数月将出现极端天气，并宣布进入紧急状态。这种被称为“超级厄尔尼诺”的全球气候现象已打破气温纪录，并引发预测称加利福尼亚等地将迎来一个异常多雨的冬季——在加利福尼亚，厄尔尼诺通常会带来更严重的冬季风暴和洪水风险。 近期，加利福尼亚州多座沿海城市因飓风“玛丽”及“厄尔尼诺”现象的影响，遭遇了巨浪、洪涝和海岸侵蚀。专家表示，这些影响预示了今冬可能出现的状况。继续阅读...
